predictions.description: Candidate entities for the missing end, best first.

score.description: The model's logit for this link; higher is more likely.

probability.description: Sigmoid of the score: the model's probability that the link holds.

known.description: Whether this link is already one of the given triples.

predicting.description: Which end was predicted: tail (head given) or head (tail given).

entities.description: Number of distinct entities in the graph.

relations.description: Number of distinct relations in the graph (inverses not counted).
